elements.element: Vendor must maintain commercial general liability insurance with a limit of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The added clause requires IBM to maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain commercial general liability insurance with an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added clause requires an aggregate commercial general liability limit of not less than USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added clause requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The condition is applicable because the operative text contemplates IBM processing personal information for Customer. The added clause requires at least USD 5,000,000 of cyber and privacy liability insurance whenever IBM processes, stores, or has access to data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Customer.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: The added clause expressly requires IBM to maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.

elements.element: Vendor must provide certificates of insurance upon request.
elements.evidence: The added clause requires IBM to provide certificates of insurance to Customer on request.

elements.evidence: The added clause requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000, exceeding the fallback minimum.

result.reason: The operative addition fully implements every preferred insurance requirement and therefore also exceeds both stated fallback limits. It adds only the requested insurance obligations, leaves the original risk-of-loss, data-processing, and geographic provisions unchanged, and introduces no contradiction.
